Both companies report on a comparable fiscal-year basis (calendar year ending Dec 31 for both FY2023 and FY2024), so the comparison is directly apples-to-apples.

- Meta Platforms revenue grew from $134,902M (FY2023) to $164,501M (FY2024), a growth rate of **≈21.94%** [DOC: Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017].
- Amazon.com net sales grew from $574,785M (FY2023) to $637,959M (FY2024), a growth rate of **≈10.99%** [DOC: Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004].

Meta's revenue growth outpaced Amazon's by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% vs. 10.99%).

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (Meta ~21.94% vs. Amazon ~10.99%).
